definitions.explanation: A point of mutual agreement or compromise reached between parties with different interests or opinions.
The state of one's relationship with another person, especially whether they get along well or not.

examples.japanese: {折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧
⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかなかった。
examples.english: We couldn't reach an agreement on the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧、⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We managed to reach a compromise and finalize the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧
examples.english: to not get along with one's boss
I get along well with him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧、⟦{帰省|きせい}→帰省：12419_kisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{憂鬱|ゆううつ}→憂鬱：05821_yuuutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: I don't get along with my mother-in-law, so visiting home is depressing.

notes:
USAGE: Often used in the expression {折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to reach a compromise) or {折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく (to come to an agreement). For sense 2, typically used with ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ to describe relationships.

NUANCE: {折|お}り{合|あ}い suggests finding a middle ground through negotiation rather than one side winning. In the relationship sense, it focuses on interpersonal harmony and compatibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to reach a compromise)
- {折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく (to come to an agreement)
- {折|お}り{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (to get along well/poorly)
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{折|お}り{合|あ}い (relationship with ~)

- ⟦{譲歩|じょうほ}→譲歩：09143_jouho⟧ (concession - more formal)
